hypotheses.D0_selection_is_label_blind: Candidate selection uses only previously frozen geometry, recurrence, size, coherence, and margin fields before token decoding.
hypotheses.D1_candidate_set_is_broad: At least twelve candidates from at least six distinct layers survive the strict selection gates.
hypotheses.D2_natural_examples_are_diverse: Every decoded candidate has at least sixteen distinct source token IDs among its top 64 discovery edges.
hypotheses.D3_examples_support_prospective_labels: Every candidate saves route cosine, source/destination context, copy relations, and direct output-token hints for later frozen semantic hypotheses.
